subject: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Morgan <security@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2)

Hi Elaine  1 thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of what we heard during the call:
- You expect to process PHI in our system (clinical notes + patient identifiers) for the initial pilot.
- Primary concerns: BAA, SOC2 evidence, KMS/HSM key control, and audit logging for model access.
- Desired latency: sub-500ms 95p for chat use cases; throughput ~ 50 qps for peak flows.
- Preferred deployment modes discussed: Hosted API w/ BAA (fastest), Dedicated capacity (isolated GPUs, reserved throughput), Private VPC / on-prem (full control, required for some regulated workflows).

Open questions for you (so we can tailor the proposal):
1) Do you require customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) or is cloud-managed encryption acceptable for the pilot?
2) Are there any audited data retention windows or purge requirements we should model for logs/cache?
3) For the pilot, do you prefer we spin a Dedicated environment or provide an evaluation on Hosted API first?

What Redwood can provide immediately:
- SOC2 Type II report (attached) and security artifact portal access for in-depth evidence.
- Draft BAA for your legal review (attached).
- Option to run a 30-day evaluation on Hosted API (faster) or a 90-day Dedicated POC with reserved capacity and isolation.
- Support for VPC peering and on-prem packaging if you need a Private deployment for the regulated workflow.

Proposed next steps:
- Elaine: confirm KMS preference and any retention/purge SLAs by EOD Thu (22 Apr).
- Redwood: circulate SOC2 + BAA, proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for Dedicated POC if you want to go that route.
- Schedule follow-up: 30min on Fri (23 Apr) to review MAP and deployment options.

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf, Redwood-BAA-Draft-2027.docx

Thanks  1
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Morgan <elaine.morgan@elarahealth.com>

Cc: procurement@elarahealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2)

Neha  1 thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying items from our security team: 

- Confirmed: PHI will be processed for the pilot. We need BAA coverage before sending any production data.
- KMS: we require customer-managed keys for any environment that will store PHI long-term; for the pilot short-lived keys managed by Redwood are acceptable if keys are rotated and we have audit logs.
- Audit evidence: we will need access to your SOC2 Type II report and a point of contact for audit evidence requests. Would you provide an artifact portal or a checklist for what you can share?
- Deployment preference: for the regulated workflows we will likely require Dedicated capacity or Private VPC/on-prem. We are open to starting on Hosted API for initial evaluation but need a clear migration path to Dedicated/Private.

Also please share your standard SLA for Dedicated (uptime/latency objectives) and any limits on egress/data retention.

I can confirm KMS preference and retention windows after reviewing your SOC2 artifacts  1 aiming to respond by Thu EOD.

Thanks,
Elaine Morgan
Director, Information Security
Elara Health
elaine.morgan@elarahealth.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Morgan <elaine.morgan@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2)

Hi Elaine  1 great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers inline and next steps below.

- SOC2 artifacts / evidence: attached SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf; we will also provide temporary access to our security artifact portal for specific evidence requests (control mappings, control owner contacts). I'll include the portal link in the MAP.

- KMS/HSM: for Dedicated and Private VPC we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS CMKs or external HSM integration). For Hosted API we offer cloud-managed encryption with detailed key rotation and access logs; we can add restrictions and shorter retention for pilot data.

- SLA and performance: Dedicated capacity offers an SLA-backed uptime commitment and predictable throughput. Typical latency for chat-like workloads at your target qps (50 qps) is ~200-350ms p95 depending on model/quantization. We'll include a detailed SLO table in the MAP.

- Migration path: Hosted API -> Dedicated -> Private VPC is a supported path; model versions and routing policies will be preserved during migration. We'll include migration steps and estimated timelines in the MAP.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level):
1) Thu 22 Apr: Elara confirms KMS preference + retention windows.
2) Fri 23 Apr: 30-min review meeting (confirm whether to start Hosted eval or Dedicated POC).
3) Week of 4 May: If Dedicated chosen, Redwood provisions Dedicated test environment (isolated tenant) and shares access.
4) May: Data ingestion test using redacted PHI, monitoring and audit runbook.
5) BAA signature & go/no-go to send production PHI.

Attachments included again: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf, Redwood-BAA-Draft-2027.docx

Can we pencil in Fri 23 Apr 11:00am PT for the 30-min follow-up? If that works I will send the calendar invite and include our solutions engineer.

Best,
Neha
